parameters.name: ProbableCause
parameters.description: Qualifies the alarm and provides further information than {{param|EventType}}.

parameters.name: SpecificProblem
parameters.description: Provides further qualification on the alarm beyond {{param|EventType}} and {{param|ProbableCause}}. This is vendor defined and will be {{empty}} if the device doesn't support unique indexing of the table using {{param}}. The string can be set to "*" to indicate the default case if only a subset of {{param}} are to be contained within the table.

parameters.name: PerceivedSeverity
parameters.description: Indicates the relative level of urgency for operator attention, see {{bibref|ITU-X.733}}. {{enum}} This will be {{empty}} if the device doesn't support unique indexing of the table using {{param}}. The string can be set to "*" to indicate the default case if only a subset of {{param}} are to be contained within the table.

parameters.name: ReportingMechanism
parameters.description: Indicates the reporting mechanism setting of the alarm. {{enum}}

object.description: Supported Alarm Entries which can be raised by the device. The instance numbers for this table SHOULD be maintained across firmware upgrades of the device.
